NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: 1080p download quality
patches.description: Upgrades the High offline download quality tier to 1080p and selects the single best matching video track.

patches.name: ASS subtitle style & margin override
patches.description: Customizes ASS subtitle font scale, bottom margin, outline, shadow, and colors, and adapts subtitle viewport margins to the active video aspect ratio and resize mode.

options.title: Subtitle font scale
options.description: Multiplier applied to ASS subtitle font sizes (0.25 to 4.0).

options.title: Scale inline \fs tags
options.description: Also scales inline {\fsN} tags on non-positioned dialogue lines (skips lines using \pos or \move).

options.title: ASS bottom MarginV offset
options.description: Vertical offset added to bottom-aligned ASS styles and events (normalized to 720p PlayResY; positive moves subtitles up).

options.title: Extra bottom screen margin (dp)
options.description: Additional bottom viewport margin in dp passed to the subtitle renderer (positive moves subtitles up).

options.title: Outline thickness
options.description: Overrides ASS style Outline thickness (0.0 to 10.0), or 'default' to keep script values.

options.title: Shadow depth
options.description: Overrides ASS style Shadow depth (0.0 to 10.0), or 'default' to keep script values.

options.title: Primary text color
options.description: Overrides ASS PrimaryColour (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or ASS &HAABBGGRR), or 'default' to keep script values.

options.title: Outline color
options.description: Overrides ASS OutlineColour (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB, or ASS &HAABBGGRR), or 'default' to keep script values.

options.title: Adapt margins to aspect & resize mode
options.description: Replaces Crunchyroll's hardcoded 16:9 Fit margin math with true video aspect ratio and Fit/Zoom/Fill resize-mode awareness, refreshing immediately when resize mode changes.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.

patches.name: Aspect mode cycle & persistence
patches.description: Cycles video aspect modes (Fit, Zoom, Fill) on pinch and remembers the selected mode across sessions.

options.title: Enable 3-way aspect cycle
options.description: Cycles Fit -> Zoom -> Fill -> Fit when pinching out instead of toggling only Fit and Zoom.

options.title: Default aspect mode
options.description: Initial video aspect mode before a user pinch selection is saved.

patches.name: Auto-skip segments
patches.description: Automatically skips intros, recaps, credits, previews, or promos in the video player.

options.title: Auto-skip intros
options.description: Automatically skip opening/intro segments.

options.title: Auto-skip recaps
options.description: Automatically skip episode recap segments.

options.title: Auto-skip credits
options.description: Automatically skip ending credits (preserves post-credits scenes when present).

options.title: Auto-skip next-episode previews
options.description: Automatically skip next-episode preview segments.

options.title: Auto-skip promos
options.description: Automatically skip promotional segments.

patches.name: Controls auto-hide timeout
patches.description: Customizes the delay before player controls automatically hide, or disables auto-hiding.

options.title: Controls auto-hide timeout (ms)
options.description: Delay in milliseconds before player controls auto-hide. Set to 0 or less to keep controls visible until toggled.

patches.name: Disable background services
patches.description: Disables background broadcast receivers, schedulers, widget polling, Firebase sessions initialization and service binding, and DataTransport JobScheduler tasks to eliminate background wakeups and idle battery drain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment initialization, Mux events, advertising ID lookup, Firebase Analytics pre-init, Crashlytics NDK native loading, Braze session and push flush alarms, and Datadog uploads; disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads, and selects disabled Datadog setup.

patches.name: Hide feed & show promos
patches.description: Hides promotional cards, vertical promo rows, floating action buttons, and show-page promo banners.

options.title: Hide CR Arc feed card
options.description: Prevents the CR Arc promotional card from being injected into the home feed.

options.title: Hide hero carousel
options.description: Hides the top hero banner carousel on the home feed.

options.title: Hide game promo cards
options.description: Hides standalone game promotional cards in the home feed.

options.title: Hide media promo cards
options.description: Hides standalone media promotional cards in the home feed.

options.title: Hide Games rows
options.description: Hides Crunchyroll Games collection rows from the home feed.

options.title: Hide Manga rows
options.description: Hides Crunchyroll Manga collection rows from the home feed.

options.title: Hide Music rows
options.description: Hides music collection rows from the home feed.

options.title: Hide Go Premium button
options.description: Hides the floating Go Premium button overlay on the home feed.

options.title: Hide promotional FAB
options.description: Hides the floating promotional action button on the home feed.

options.title: Hide CR Arc FAB
options.description: Hides the floating CR Arc quick-access action button on the home feed.

options.title: Hide show page promo banner
options.description: Hides the cross-promo banner shown on series pages.

patches.name: Hide maturity rating overlay
patches.description: Hides the maturity rating overlay when starting or resuming playback.

patches.name: Manual video quality
patches.description: Replaces the preset quality tiers with manual per-resolution selection and Auto.

patches.name: Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enables native Picture-in-Picture playback support.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Unhides the player's speed menu and expands playback speed options up to 4.0x.

options.title: Maximum playback speed
options.description: Highest playback speed multiplier shown in the player speed menu.

patches.name: Player gestures
patches.description: Enables pinch-to-zoom, double-tap-to-seek, and vertical swipe gestures for brightness and volume.

options.title: Enable pinch-to-zoom
options.description: Allows pinching on the video player to zoom or cycle aspect modes.

options.title: Enable double-tap-to-seek
options.description: Enables double-tapping the left or right side of the player to seek.

options.title: Enable brightness swipe
options.description: Allows swiping vertically on the left side of the player to adjust screen brightness.

options.title: Enable volume swipe
options.description: Allows swiping vertically on the right side of the player to adjust media volume.

patches.name: Player preference defaults
patches.description: Overrides initial default values for audio language, subtitles, autoplay, cellular streaming, closed captions, audio description, and playback speed.

options.title: Default audio language
options.description: Initial player audio locale when no user preference has been saved yet.

options.title: Default subtitle language
options.description: Initial player subtitle locale when no user preference has been saved yet.

options.title: Default autoplay
options.description: Initial state for auto-playing the next episode.

options.title: Default stream over cellular
options.description: Initial state for allowing video streaming over cellular data.

options.title: Default closed captions
options.description: Initial state for showing closed captions when available.

options.title: Default audio description
options.description: Initial state for audio description tracks.

options.title: Default playback speed
options.description: Initial playback speed multiplier when no user preference has been saved yet.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.title: SOCKS proxy host
options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.

options.title: SOCKS proxy port
options.description: Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.

options.title: SOCKS proxy username
options.description: Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.

options.title: SOCKS proxy password
options.description: Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.

options.title: Local token diagnostics
options.description: Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.

patches.name: Remaining time toggle
patches.description: Allows tapping the player timestamp or duration to toggle between elapsed time and remaining time (-MM:SS).

options.title: Start in remaining time mode
options.description: Displays remaining time (-MM:SS) by default before tapping the timestamp.

patches.name: Screen & orientation lock
patches.description: Adds a screen lock toggle to the player toolbar and locks orientation against accidental rotation.

options.title: Add screen lock button
options.description: Adds a lock icon to the player toolbar that blocks touch input until unlocked via the floating Unlock pill.

options.title: Lock orientation while screen is locked
options.description: Prevents device rotation from exiting or entering fullscreen while the player screen is locked.

options.title: Always ignore rotation fullscreen changes
options.description: Prevents device rotation from automatically toggling fullscreen even when the screen is unlocked.

patches.name: Seek interval
patches.description: Customizes the double-tap and rewind/fast-forward seek interval in the video player.

options.title: Seek interval (seconds)
options.description: Number of seconds to rewind or fast-forward when double-tapping or pressing skip buttons.

patches.name: Skip animated splash
patches.description: Skips the animated startup splash video and its audio focus request, and skips cold-start checkout WebView preloading.

options.title: Skip animated splash video
options.description: Skips the 6-second animated splash video and AudioFocus request on startup.

options.title: Skip RazorPay WebView preload
options.description: Skips preloading the RazorPay checkout WebView on the main thread during app startup.

patches.name: Suppress bloat workers
patches.description: Forces Google Engage, Continue Watching, Datadog, and OneTrust CMP background workers to return success immediately without performing network requests, disk I/O, or image prefetching.

patches.name: Suppress modals & prompts
patches.description: Suppresses Braze in-app message overlays, Play in-app review prompts, Play in-app update prompts, and the startup notification permission prompt.

options.title: Discard Braze in-app messages
options.description: Discards Braze promotional in-app message overlays immediately instead of displaying or deferring them.

options.title: Disable Play in-app review
options.description: Prevents the Google Play in-app review rating prompt from being bound and launched.

options.title: Disable Play in-app updates
options.description: Disables Google Play in-app update checks and hides the in-app update prompt banner.

options.title: Suppress notification permission prompt
options.description: Prevents the automatic POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission prompt on startup.

patches.name: Up Next banner window
patches.description: Customizes how many seconds before the end of an episode the Up Next banner appears.

options.title: Up Next banner window (seconds)
options.description: Seconds before the end of playback when the Up Next banner appears. Set to 0 to suppress early appearance.
